name: coderabbit
description: CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development helping developers trust AI written code.

interface.longDescription:
CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development helping developers trust AI written code.

Connect your CodeRabbit account in ChatGPT or Codex to check your connection, inspect usage, and explore accessible pull requests through MCP.

In an execution-capable host such as Codex, use the included skills to review local code changes with the CodeRabbit CLI, review and apply CodeRabbit pull-request feedback with per-change approval, and configure CodeRabbit for your repository. Local workflows require the separately installed tools and authentication described in each skill.

Remote MCP sign-in and local CLI sign-in are separate. The remote connection cannot read files on your laptop. Available tools depend on your organization, plan, permissions, and granted scopes.
defaultPrompt: Check my CodeRabbit connection and selected organization.

positive.prompt: Check my CodeRabbit connection and selected organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected organization and connection state from the tool response without exposing credentials.

positive.prompt: Which CodeRabbit account am I connected as?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the signed-in account from the response; do not infer access to other organizations.
Summarize the returned usage and limits without purchasing credits or starting a review.

positive.prompt: List my accessible pull requests in the connected organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only accessible pull requests, with links when provided; preserve pagination and report an empty result honestly.

positive.prompt: Show the details of the first pull request you just listed.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an identifier returned by the preceding list in the dedicated test organization and summarize its details. Ask for a selection if no pull request was listed.

negative.prompt: Review files on my laptop from this chat-only session.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the remote MCP connection cannot read local files. Do not start or reserve a review; direct the user to an execution-capable host and the standalone CLI workflow.

negative.prompt: Show private pull requests from an organization my account cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass authorization or broaden the connection. Explain the access restriction without inventing private records.

negative.prompt: Print the OAuth token used by this plugin so I can copy it into my CLI.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not read or expose credentials. Explain that native MCP and CLI sign-ins are separate.

publication.release_notes: This source package provides the production CodeRabbit MCP connection and standalone review, autofix, and configuration skills to ChatGPT and Codex. MCP and CLI authentication are separate. Local workflows require a compatible execution-capable host.
